entries.name: Warrior
entries.sub: Base class; ascends into the Juggernaut or the Berserker.

p: Open to every account from the start.
At level 100 a Warrior ascends into one of two classes: the Ascendant Oracle in the teleport room's market starts the quest.

rows: The Juggernaut, an unbreakable wall: taunts, damage reduction, a shield that blocks and reflects.
The Berserker, two-handed fury: cleaving blows and a rage that grows as your blood runs out.

p: Health, mana and capacity gained per level; the base attack interval and speed.
The Trial: alone against the Warden of Iron for 3 min. It crushes those who stand their ground too long. Keep moving.
Before it, Proof of Strength: 10 points from rare (1) and legendary (3) monsters of at least 0.6 x your level.

rows: The Deadeye, the single perfect shot: crossbows, marks and critical strikes.
The Beastmaster, never alone: beasts that fight beside you and arrows that splash.

p: Health, mana and capacity gained per level; the base attack interval and speed.
The Trial: alone against the Warden of the Hunt for 3 min. Its hounds come in packs; a hunter who stands still becomes prey.
Before it, Proof of Strength: 10 points from rare (1) and legendary (3) monsters of at least 0.6 x your level.

rows: The Elementalist, master of ruin: fire, ice and energy woven into great storms.
The Illusionist, the hidden hand: strength for your allies, weakness for your foes, some healing.

p: Health, mana and capacity gained per level; the base attack interval and speed.
The Trial: alone against the Warden of the Veil for 3 min. The ground under you will burn with runes. Read the marks and step aside.
Before it, Proof of Strength: 10 points from rare (1) and legendary (3) monsters of at least 0.6 x your level.

entries.sub: Base class; ascends into the Shadowfist or the Iron Sage. Unlockable.

p: Unlockable class: reach level 200 with any character of your account. The unlock is for every character of the account.
At level 100 a Monk ascends into one of two classes: the Ascendant Oracle in the teleport room's market starts the quest.

rows: The Shadowfist, the killing touch: pressure points, flurries and chi spent in one burst.
The Iron Sage, the mountain that guards: chi wards on allies, stuns, the Mantra of Stone.

p: Health, mana and capacity gained per level; the base attack interval and speed.
The Trial: alone against the Warden of the Still Fist for 3 min. Stillness is the lesson it teaches the hard way: keep your feet moving.
Before it, Proof of Strength: 10 points from rare (1) and legendary (3) monsters of at least 0.6 x your level.

entries.name: Town Portal
entries.sub: "ash domh", level 1, 0 mana, cooldown 1 s

p: Every class, from level 1, no mana. A 3 s channel, then a portal home and a return portal beside the temple; all rules, the cooldown and the portal styles are in data/scripts/chaos/townportal.lua. The XML cooldown is only a short guard: the real cooldown (60 s) starts when the portal opens.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

entries.name: Ashen Fist
entries.sub: "kah dhun", level 8, 15 mana, cooldown 2 s

p: A quick strike at the target next to you that builds 2 chi. The Monk's builder. A Monk strike (fist power, or a staff's): Pressure Points and the Shadowfist focus crit apply.

entries.name: Bone Spear
entries.sub: "kah oss lanc", level 8, 20 mana, cooldown 2 s

p: Hurl a spear of bone at the target (range 5). Physical damage; the creature right behind the target (seen from you) takes half of it. The Necromancer line's filler. (level / 5 + magic level x 1.6..2.6 + 20..40) (necro_config.lua boneSpear; the level scale was dropped with the class trees); the Lich's Soul Hoard adds to it.

entries.name: Radiant Smite
entries.sub: "kah sol dyr", level 8, 15 mana, cooldown 2 s

p: A hammer-blow of light on one target within 3 sqm. The Templar line's holy filler (cooldown 2 s). Holy damage from the melee weapon (best of sword, club and axe skill x the main-hand attack) and a little magic level (the line's level factor was dropped with the class trees). A judged target takes more of it.

entries.name: Raise Bone Warrior
entries.sub: "vael oss brak", level 8, 30 mana, cooldown 4 s

p: A sturdy bone warrior rises next to you: a melee minion (range 1, physical) with the most health of the three. One minion per cast. You can have only a few minions of all kinds at once (3 for the Necromancer); at the limit the oldest one crumbles first (no corpse, no loot). Health and hits scale with your level and magic level (necro_config.lua minions.warrior); the minion hits the creature you target (data/scripts/chaos/necro_minions.lua).

entries.name: Shuriken Toss
entries.sub: "kah shur", level 8, 16 mana, cooldown 2 s

p: Throw a shuriken at one target; physical damage from your sword or distance skill. The Thief's filler (range 5). A ranged weapon strike: the better of sword and distance skill x a default shuriken attack (no star is carried; a one-handed distance weapon in hand raises it), so it works with a blade in hand too. It crits out of Shadow Veil and carries Poison Blades.

entries.name: Dawnpiercer
entries.sub: "kah sol aurr", level 12, 30 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: Single target holy bolt, the paladin's filler. Scales with distance skill x weapon attack (the bow's own).

entries.name: Sundering Palm
entries.sub: "kah gal dhun", level 14, 30 mana, cooldown 11 s

p: A heavy palm strike that spends all chi; the damage grows with the chi spent. Finisher: x (0.30 + 0.14 per chi) of the 5-chi formula (ChaosMonk.finisherScale). Needs at least 1 chi.

entries.name: Snare Trap
entries.sub: "drai snar", level 14, 55 mana, cooldown 4 s

p: Throws a trap up to 4 sqm (onto your attack target, else straight ahead). It arms after 0.6 s; the first monster within 1 sqm sets it off: a burst hits up to 8 enemies within 2 sqm. At most 3 traps (the oldest goes); a trap lasts 20 s. Say an element after the words (drai snar "fire": fire, ice, energy, earth, death, holy, physical) to choose what it carries; it is remembered. Without one, a brand rune in the spell picks it. Rules and numbers: data/scripts/chaos/snares_core.lua, snares_config.lua; the scheduler: _snares.lua.

rows: Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Thief, Ninja, Samurai

entries.name: Consecration
entries.sub: "drai sol haln", level 14, 50 mana, cooldown 12 s

p: Hallows the ground under the Templar for 6 seconds. Each second holy damage hits enemies within 2 sqm of the cast tile, and allies standing in it (party, own summons, the Templar) are healed a little. Pulse damage: weapon power and magic level like Radiant Smite, much smaller per pulse; allies get ChaosTemplar.cfg.consecration.allyHeal x a pulse. The zone stays where it was cast and ends when the Templar dies or logs out.

entries.name: Rime Bloom
entries.sub: "drai hyr rhim", level 14, 70 mana, cooldown 4 s

p: Ice burst around the caster, chills everything it hits.

entries.name: Reaping Gyre
entries.sub: "kah spir", level 14, 20 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: Three spinning strikes (0 / 0.4 / 0.8s) against everything adjacent. Uses weapon attack and skill.

entries.name: Raise Bone Mage
entries.sub: "vael oss mynd", level 16, 40 mana, cooldown 4 s

p: A risen mage joins you: a fragile caster minion (range 4, energy bolts) that hits harder than a skeleton. One minion per cast. You can have only a few minions of all kinds at once (3 for the Necromancer); at the limit the oldest one crumbles first (no corpse, no loot). Health and hits scale with your level and magic level (necro_config.lua minions.mage); the minion hits the creature you target (data/scripts/chaos/necro_minions.lua).

entries.name: Blade Flurry
entries.sub: "drai vas kaen", level 20, 70 mana, cooldown 9 s

p: Spin with your blades and cut every monster next to you. The Thief line's area strike (all three classes, level 50): a melee weapon strike on each monster in the 3x3 square around you (other players are never hit). On one target it hits like a Shuriken Toss; its worth is the pack. Each hit crits out of Shadow Veil, carries Poison Blades, rolls the Bushido crit and is followed by the Ninja's off-hand. Numbers and rules: _blades.lua.

entries.name: Raise Dead
entries.sub: "vael oss", level 20, 35 mana, cooldown 2 s

p: Raise minions from the corpses around you (up to 4 sqm), or one from nothing for twice the mana. The Necromancer and the Bone Lord raise Risen Skeletons (Necromancer up to 2 per cast, Bone Lord up to 3), the Lich a single Lich Shade. A corpse is used only when it holds no loot and belongs to you, your party or nobody; it is consumed. Caps, health and the minions' hits: data/scripts/chaos/necro_config.lua (minions), managed by data/scripts/chaos/necro_minions.lua.

entries.name: Vow of Mending
entries.sub: "saen tor fidh", level 20, 90 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: The Templar's self heal. Restores 8% of the maximum health + level / 5 + magic level x 4 (ChaosTemplar.cfg.vowOfMending, ChaosTemplar.vowAmount).

entries.name: Palm Shockwave
entries.sub: "drai gal dhun", level 20, 40 mana, cooldown 4 s

p: An open palm on the target next to you sends a shockwave through every monster within 2 sqm of it. The Monk line's pack strike (all three classes, level 50): the target takes an Ashen Fist (+2 chi), every other monster within 2 sqm of it twice that (a player only as the target). Numbers and rules: _packtools.lua.

entries.name: Witchfire Bolt
entries.sub: "kah pyr vesh", level 20, 40 mana, cooldown 7 s

p: Single target fire bolt that leaves the target burning.

entries.name: Purifying Wellspring
entries.sub: "saen vas aquen", level 20, 95 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: Heals the caster, party members and own summons within 3 sqm and removes harmful conditions.

entries.name: Earthbreaker
entries.sub: "kah grund krak", level 20, 30 mana, cooldown 7 s

p: Shockwave (5x5) that deals physical damage and staggers enemies (heavy slow for 3s).

entries.name: Shadow Mend
entries.sub: "saen umh", level 25, 25 mana, cooldown 1.5 s

p: Heals you for your level / 2 + magic level x 20 + 5% of your maximum health, 30% more while Shadow Veil is up. Healing does not end the veil. The Thief line's self heal (Thief, Ninja, Samurai). Numbers: Chaos.classes.shadowMend, rule ChaosClasses.shadowMendRange (+-10%); measured in server/data/spells/README.md "Healing".

entries.name: Blightswarm
entries.sub: "drai vex kriv", level 25, 90 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: Toxic cloud around the caster, poisons everything it hits.

entries.name: Hunter's Instinct
entries.sub: "ash senn", level 25, 25 mana, cooldown 10 s

p: Pings every monster within 12 sqm on the caster's floor (max 15 marked) and reports the nearest.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

entries.name: Flickerdash
entries.sub: "ash flik", level 30, 50 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: Dash up to 4 sqm in the facing direction (stops at the first blocked tile) plus 2.5s of speed.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

entries.name: Vigil of Clarity
entries.sub: "vigh lum", level 35, 0 mana, cooldown 2 s

p: Switches the vigil on or off. While on it reserves 20% of your maximum mana, and you and your party members within 5 sqm regain 1% of their maximum mana every second (not in a rift with Parched Veins). Rules: data/scripts/chaos/vigils_core.lua; the reservation and the party: vigils.lua.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

entries.name: Kindled Breath
entries.sub: "saen qhal", level 40, 60 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: Breathe the chi in and heal; the heal grows with the chi spent (the Iron Sage's heal keeps healing for 6 s). Finisher (needs 1 chi). Monk and Shadowfist: heal yourself for (level x 2 + fist x 6) x the finisher scale. Iron Sage (the line's healer): the most hurt party member within 5 sqm (yourself without a party, or when you are the most hurt) for fist x 33 x the finisher scale, and 60% more over 6 s (CONDITION_REGENERATION, sub id ChaosMonk.ids.subId.breath). The Flowing Mercy keystone (the passive tree, class_tree.lua) also heals the next most hurt for a share of it. Numbers: ChaosMonk.cfg.breath / sageBreath.

entries.name: Vigil of Haste
entries.sub: "vigh ruan", level 40, 0 mana, cooldown 2 s

p: Switches the vigil on or off. While on it reserves 20% of your maximum mana, and you and your party members within 5 sqm move 15% faster. Rules: data/scripts/chaos/vigils_core.lua; the reservation and the party: vigils.lua.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

entries.name: Withering Curse
entries.sub: "kah nyx maled", level 40, 70 mana, cooldown 7 s

p: Curse the target (range 6) for 12 s: it takes 15% more damage from everyone and rots (death damage every second, 10 ticks). The Lich's curse amplifies by 25%, rots harder and also curses up to 2 more enemies within 2 sqm of the target. On a player the curse only rots (no amplify). The amplify is applied by data/scripts/chaos/necromancer_combat.lua (ChaosNecroCurse); numbers: necro_config.lua witheringCurse.

entries.name: Hall of Mirrors
entries.sub: "drai spek", level 40, 150 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: Up to 3 decoys wearing the caster's outfit, they vanish after 10s. Needs the "Clone" monster (data/monster/lua/clones/clone.lua in the reference server).

entries.name: Shadow Veil
entries.sub: "fen umh", level 40, 70 mana, cooldown 20 s

p: Vanish for 4 seconds; monsters lose you and your first weapon hit out of it is a critical hit. Stealth (Chaos.classes.stealth): an invisibility condition with the class sub id. Every pulse, monsters around drop the player as a target and take it off their target lists, so they cannot pick it again; a monster that still targets it cannot attack it (data/scripts/chaos/thief_combat.lua). Dealing damage or taking a hit ends it. Not aggressive: casting it does not end it. When it ends the monsters get the player back on their target lists.

entries.name: Grave Nova
entries.sub: "drai nyx oss", level 50, 80 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: The grave breathes out around you; every enemy within 3 sqm takes death damage. The Necromancer's area attack (level 50, after Withering Curse; no target needed). Each hit: (level / 5 + magic level x 1.8..2.8 + 25..45) (necro_config.lua graveNova), the class spell factor on top. A cursed monster takes the curse's +15% / +25% like every other hit. Players are hit only where PvP allows it.

entries.name: Whirling Heel
entries.sub: "drai spir dhun", level 50, 50 mana, cooldown 9 s

p: A spinning kick that spends all chi and hits everything next to you. Finisher, area 3x3 around the Monk (the engine's area rules: PvP, protection zones, summons). Damage x the finisher scale of the chi spent.

entries.name: Forked Storm
entries.sub: "kah zhul zarn", level 50, 120 mana, cooldown 7 s

p: Hits the target, then jumps to up to 3 more monsters within 3 sqm (full damage on every jump).

entries.name: Ironhold
entries.sub: "tor brak", level 55, 120 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: +40% shielding for 12 s. No pacify and no lock on other spells: the weapon keeps swinging.

entries.name: Mirror Mend
entries.sub: "saen spek", level 60, 110 mana, cooldown 2 s

p: The Illusionist heals the most hurt party member within 7 sqm (or the one named: saen spek "Name"), and a mirror image of the heal mends the next most hurt (the Illusionist included) for 25% of it. Without a hurt party member it heals the Illusionist. Numbers: ChaosHealing.cfg.mirrorMend (data/scripts/chaos/healing_rules_core.lua). Weaver's Grace and the PvP healing reduction apply through data/scripts/chaos/healing_rules.lua.

entries.name: Seeker Mine
entries.sub: "kah snar", level 60, 65 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: Throws a mine up to 4 sqm (onto your attack target, else straight ahead). It arms after 0.8 s and waits for Detonate Mines or its 8 s fuse; then a burst hits up to 8 enemies within 2 sqm for 1.15 times a trap's hit. At most 5 mines (the oldest goes). The element works as for Snare Trap (kah snar "ice"). Rules and numbers: data/scripts/chaos/snares_core.lua, snares_config.lua; the scheduler: _snares.lua.

entries.name: Detonate Mines
entries.sub: "vok snar", level 60, 20 mana, cooldown 1 s

p: Every armed mine you threw goes off, 0.1 s apart, oldest first. Rules: data/scripts/chaos/snares_core.lua (detonate); the scheduler: _snares.lua.

entries.name: Tautstring
entries.sub: "vyr sag", level 60, 180 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: +25% distance skill for 12 s. No slow and no lock on other spells: the bow keeps firing.

entries.name: Sanctified Ground
entries.sub: "drai sol sanct", level 60, 50 mana, cooldown 4 s

p: The ground under you flares with holy light three times; everything within 2 sqm is burned. The Templar's pack spell (level 60): 3 pulses of holy damage, one a second, on the creatures within 2 sqm of the cast tile (the engine's area rules). Weapon power and magic level like Radiant Smite. Numbers: _packtools.lua.

entries.name: Vigil of Wrath
entries.sub: "vigh vyr", level 60, 0 mana, cooldown 2 s

p: Switches the vigil on or off. While on it reserves 35% of your maximum mana, and you and your party members within 5 sqm deal 5% more damage (not on top of Inspiring Illusion: the stronger counts). Rules: data/scripts/chaos/vigils_core.lua; the reservation and the party: vigils.lua.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

entries.name: Bone Shrapnel
entries.sub: "drai oss krak", level 60, 60 mana, cooldown 4 s

p: The bones of your target burst outward; it and every monster next to it are cut by the shards. The Necromancer's pack spell (level 60, range 7): physical damage on the target and on every monster within 1 sqm of it, each a Bone Spear's hit. Players are only hit when they are the target. Numbers and rules: _packtools.lua.

entries.name: Ironbark Hide
entries.sub: "tor ael skar", level 60, 85 mana, cooldown 25 s

p: +20% max health and steady regeneration for 20s.

entries.name: Skewering Line
entries.sub: "kah sag lanc", level 60, 90 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: A 7 sqm line of spears hitting everything in it. Every target takes a Dawnpiercer hit (owner, 2026-10-20: an area hit equals the single-target hit). Scales with distance skill x weapon attack.

entries.name: Banner Call
entries.sub: "tor vas vant", level 60, 150 mana, cooldown 35 s

p: Caster and party members within 5 sqm get +10% melee/distance/magic and speed for 12s.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

entries.name: Poison Blades
entries.sub: "vyr vex thyss", level 60, 90 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: For 20 seconds your weapon hits poison the target. Each weapon hit (and weapon strike of a spell) adds a share of its damage as earth damage over 4 seconds (Chaos.classes.poisonBlades; applied by data/scripts/chaos/thief_combat.lua, which sees the buff as a condition with the class sub id).

entries.name: Vigil of Iron
entries.sub: "vigh tor", level 60, 0 mana, cooldown 2 s

p: Switches the vigil on or off. While on it reserves 35% of your maximum mana, and you and your party members within 5 sqm take 6% less damage (not on top of the Templar line's defence aura: the stronger counts). Rules: data/scripts/chaos/vigils_core.lua; the reservation and the party: vigils.lua.

rows: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

entries.name: Hollow Knuckle
entries.sub: "kah hol dhun", level 70, 45 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: A knuckle strike at the target next to you that builds 1 chi. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key hollowknuckle): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Marrow Bolt
entries.sub: "kah oss sag", level 70, 135 mana, cooldown 7 s

p: A bolt of bone marrow, one death hit on one target. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key marrowbolt): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Briar Prison
entries.sub: "drai thral brin", level 70, 200 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: Thorns erupt around the target for 3 pulses, rooting enemies in a 3x3 for 5s.

entries.name: Umbral Stride
entries.sub: "ruan nyx umh", level 70, 70 mana, cooldown 10 s

p: Teleport to the far side of the target (range 5) and stab it with death damage.

entries.name: Hallowed Cut
entries.sub: "kah sol brak", level 80, 60 mana, cooldown 7 s

p: A blessed cut at the target next to you, holy damage from your weapon. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key hallowedcut): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Fan of Knives
entries.sub: "drai vas nyx shur", level 80, 90 mana, cooldown 10 s

p: Throw a fan of knives at your target and up to 5 more monsters around you. The Thief's pack spell (the Thief only, level 80, range 4): a ranged weapon strike of Shuriken Toss's formula on the target and on the nearest 5 monsters within 4 sqm of you (stealth crit, Poison Blades). Players are only hit when they are the target. Numbers and rules: _packtools.lua.

entries.name: Soulward
entries.sub: "tor anh", level 80, 90 mana, cooldown 40 s

p: Mana shield for 15s plus mana regeneration while it lasts (the stock Ward of the Mind has no regen).

rows: Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel

entries.name: Quaking Stomp
entries.sub: "drai krak dhun", level 90, 60 mana, cooldown 7 s

p: A stomp that shakes every enemy next to you and builds 1 chi. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key quakingstomp): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Wraithwind
entries.sub: "drai nyx vael", level 90, 180 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: A cold wind of the dead over the 3 x 3 sqm in front of you. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key wraithwind): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Heretic's Brand
entries.sub: "kah sol putr", level 90, 90 mana, cooldown 13 s

p: A brand burned into a heretic: one heavy holy hit on one target. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key hereticsbrand): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Gutting Slash
entries.sub: "kah vorn kaen", level 100, 60 mana, cooldown 7 s

p: A quick cut at the target next to you, a melee weapon strike. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key guttingslash): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Pressure Points
entries.sub: "kah mynd dhun", level 100, 70 mana, cooldown 7 s

p: Strike a nerve of the target next to you: 1 chi, and a stack of Pressure Points on it (+5% damage from Monks, up to 5 stacks, 8 s). Each stack (max 5, 8 s, refreshed by every cast) makes the target take +5% from Monks' hits and strikes. The stacks are timer conditions on the target, one sub id per stack (ChaosMonk.ids.subId.pressure), which data/scripts/chaos/monk_combat.lua counts.

entries.name: Chi Ward
entries.sub: "tor qhal", level 100, 120 mana, cooldown 12 s

p: Spend all chi on a shield of chi around a party member (or yourself) that absorbs damage for 8 s. Finisher: absorbs (level x 2.5 + fist x 8) x the finisher scale. `tor qhal "Name"` shields that party member within 5 sqm; without a name it shields the party member within 5 sqm with the lowest health share (you when you have no party). The shield is a timer condition on the recipient (ChaosMonk.ids.subId.ward) and the amount left a storage on it (ChaosMonk.ids.storage.wardAmount); monk_combat.lua absorbs from it. A new ward replaces the old one.

entries.name: Censer Swing
entries.sub: "drai sol hrak", level 100, 70 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: A swung censer; every enemy next to you takes holy damage. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key censerswing): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Soul Rot
entries.sub: "kah nyx putr", level 100, 130 mana, cooldown 11 s

p: Rot the target's soul (range 6): heavy death damage every second for 6 s. If the target dies before the rot ends, the rest jumps to the nearest enemy within 3 sqm. A recast on the same target restarts it. Ticks: (level / 5 + magic level x 1.2..1.6 + 20..40) x 1.15 x the level scale, Soul Hoard included (necro_config.lua soulRot).

entries.name: Bone Golem
entries.sub: "vael gal oss", level 100, 300 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: Raise the Bone Golem, a hulking construct of bone (one at a time, on top of your skeletons). It slams every enemy next to it and taunts the monsters around it. With the golem out, the cast calls it back to your side and heals half of its health. Health and slams scale with your level and magic level (necro_config.lua minions.golem, golemClass); its hits are dealt as you (data/scripts/chaos/necro_minions.lua).

entries.name: Judgement
entries.sub: "kah sol vehm", level 100, 75 mana, cooldown 4 s

p: The Inquisitor brands one target (range 5) with a holy strike. For 8 seconds the target takes 20% more holy damage from every source, the party's included (ChaosTemplar.cfg.judgement; applied by data/scripts/chaos/templar_combat.lua, which sees the brand as a timer condition on the target).

entries.name: Blessed Earth
entries.sub: "drai vas sol hal", level 100, 210 mana, cooldown 9 s

p: Consecrates the caster's tile for 6s. Each second holy damage hits enemies within 2 sqm and allies (party, own summons, caster) standing in it are healed a little.

entries.name: Red Frenzy
entries.sub: "vyr ira cruor", level 100, 180 mana, cooldown 40 s

p: +30% melee skill, -30% shield skill for 12s. (Not the stock Bloodlust.)

entries.name: Shadow Step
entries.sub: "ash umh", level 100, 90 mana, cooldown 13 s

p: Step through the shadows behind your target and stab it. Teleports to the free tile around the target farthest from where the Ninja stood (range 5) and strikes it. A melee weapon strike: the off-hand follows it when dual wielding, it crits out of Shadow Veil and carries Poison Blades.

entries.name: Counter Stance
entries.sub: "tor ryx", level 100, 60 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: For 3 seconds the next melee hit you take is parried and answered with a strike, every other hit you take is 30% smaller, and the monsters within 3 sqm turn on you (the Samurai is the line's duelist off-tank). The answer does 1.5x the parried hit (Chaos.classes.counter; done by data/scripts/chaos/thief_combat.lua, which sees the stance as a condition with the class sub id).

entries.name: Wild Bond
entries.sub: "vael ferh", level 100, 180 mana, cooldown 10 s

p: Call your companion (a war wolf; 2 from level 400). Companions already out are called back to your side and healed for half their health. The Beastmaster's companion: its health scales with your level, its bites with your level and distance skill, and it attacks your target (data/scripts/chaos/beastmaster.lua, numbers in Chaos.classes.companion).

entries.name: Rebuke
entries.sub: "vok sol kal", level 100, 90 mana, cooldown 12 s

p: The Sentinel calls every monster within 4 sqm to face it (taunt) and slows them 25% for 6 seconds (ChaosTemplar.cfg.rebuke). Only monsters that are not player summons; players are never touched.

entries.name: Gravewail
entries.sub: "drai oss ul", level 110, 200 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: The grave wails at the target; every enemy within 2 sqm of it takes death damage. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key gravewail): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Bulwark Slam
entries.sub: "kah sol aeg", level 110, 60 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: A slam of your shield arm at the target next to you, holy damage from your weapon. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key bulwarkslam): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Shattered Psyche
entries.sub: "kah mynd frak", level 110, 120 mana, cooldown 9 s

p: Death damage bolt, then a cursing damage-over-time and a short slow.

entries.name: Feral Command
entries.sub: "kah ferh", level 110, 120 mana, cooldown 4 s

p: Your companions leap at the target (range 7) and maul it, each for 1.5 bites at once. The Beastmaster's command. A bite is physical damage dealt as you, from your level and distance skill (ChaosClasses.biteValues, Chaos.classes.companion); it needs a companion out (Wild Bond).

entries.name: Iron Palm
entries.sub: "kah brak dhun", level 120, 120 mana, cooldown 12 s

p: Spend all chi on an iron-hard palm at the target next to you; it stuns a monster for 1-2.6 s and a player for 0.6-1 s. Finisher: damage x the finisher scale; a stunned monster stands still and cannot attack (monk_combat.lua cancels its attacks while the stun condition lasts). Stun 0.6 s + 0.4 s per chi; afterwards the monster cannot be stunned for 4 s. A monster with more than 50000 max health is only slowed by 50%. A player is stunned by monk_combat.lua when the strike's damage lands on it (ChaosMonk.cfg.stun.pvp: 0.5 s + 0.1 s per chi, 6 s immunity, half as long within 15 s of the last stun); the spell only tells it the chi spent.

entries.name: Chi Lance
entries.sub: "kah lanc dhun", level 120, 145 mana, cooldown 10 s

p: A finisher: all your chi leaves in a line 4 sqm long; the damage grows with the chi spent. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key chilance): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Lucid Reverie
entries.sub: "reth vas spek", level 120, 180 mana, cooldown 20 s

p: A shared waking dream. The Illusionist and every party member within 7 sqm are healed 5 times, every 2 seconds (a heal over time that follows them: a member farther than 10 sqm or on another floor misses the pulse). Numbers: ChaosHealing.cfg.lucidReverie (data/scripts/chaos/healing_rules_core.lua). Weaver's Grace and the PvP healing reduction apply to every pulse through data/scripts/chaos/healing_rules.lua. Stops if the Illusionist dies or logs out.

entries.name: Penitent Lash
entries.sub: "kah sol vael", level 120, 70 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: A lash of penance over the 3 x 2 sqm in front of you. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key penitentlash): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Banner of Bones
entries.sub: "tor vas oss", level 120, 180 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: For 20 s your minions deal 30% more damage, take 25% less and regenerate 3% of their health every second. A timer condition on you (necro_config.lua subId.boneAura) that data/scripts/chaos/necro_minions.lua reads.

entries.name: Purging Nova
entries.sub: "drai gal sol orr", level 120, 105 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: Holy fire bursts from the Inquisitor (circle of 3 sqm). It heals the Inquisitor for 10% of the damage dealt, at most 5% of its maximum health per cast (ChaosTemplar.cfg.purgingNova). A normal area combat (the engine's PvP rules apply). The heal counts the formula average per creature hit.

entries.name: Moonfang Pack
entries.sub: "vael luth wyrd", level 120, 270 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: Summons 2 wolves (3 from level 200) for 40s. Tries "Spirit Wolf", "Winter Wolf", "Wolf" in that order.

entries.name: Iron Bellow
entries.sub: "vok vas rhov", level 120, 120 mana, cooldown 20 s

p: Taunts every monster within 4 sqm and slows them 25% for 6s. The knight gains Iron Will for 8s: 25% less damage taken (data/scripts/chaos/spell_guard.lua) and +15% shielding.

entries.name: Iaijutsu
entries.sub: "kah gal kaen", level 120, 210 mana, cooldown 13 s

p: Gather for a moment, then cut your target with one heavy draw strike. The Samurai charges for 0.8 s, then strikes the target if it is still within 2 sqm. A melee weapon strike: it rolls the Bushido Focus crit, crits out of Shadow Veil and carries Poison Blades.

entries.name: Bloodrage
entries.sub: "vyr sang khar", level 120, 120 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: Pay 10% of your current health; for 12 s Rage gets +10% on top and every melee weapon hit also strikes up to 4 other enemies next to you for 40% of the hit. The Berserker's frenzy. The health it costs feeds Rage (the passive bonus grows as health drops). Applied by data/scripts/chaos/berserker_combat.lua, which sees the buff as a condition with the class sub id (Chaos.classes.subId.bloodrage, numbers in Chaos.classes.bloodrage).

entries.name: Aegis of Faith
entries.sub: "tor gal sol aeg", level 120, 90 mana, cooldown 25 s

p: The Sentinel raises its shield and its faith: for 5 seconds it takes 40% less damage (ChaosTemplar.cfg.aegis; applied by data/scripts/chaos/templar_combat.lua, which sees the timer condition). Needs a shield in hand.

entries.name: Gorehook
entries.sub: "kah sang hrak", level 130, 45 mana, cooldown 12 s

p: A hooked blow at the target next to you that opens it; it bleeds for 5 s. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key gorehook): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Phantom Needles
entries.sub: "kah mynd sag", level 130, 275 mana, cooldown 11 s

p: Needles of a dream, one violet hit on one target. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key phantomneedles): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Razor Rain
entries.sub: "drai shur vex", level 130, 75 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: Blades fall in a circle of 2 sqm around the target, a ranged weapon strike on each. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key razorrain): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Life Siphon
entries.sub: "kah sang nyx", level 130, 155 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: Drain the target's life (range 5): three death strikes half a second apart; you heal for half of the damage they deal. Strikes: (level / 5 + magic level x 1.1..1.6 + 20..40) x 1.15 x the level scale, Soul Hoard included (necro_config.lua lifeSiphon).

entries.name: Blightbrand
entries.sub: "kah putr brak", level 135, 310 mana, cooldown 12 s

p: A brand of blight that burns in the target for 6 s. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key blightbrand): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Packhunter's Dart
entries.sub: "kah ferh sag", level 140, 50 mana, cooldown 10 s

p: A venom dart at the quarry the pack is circling. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key packdart): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Martyr's Pyre
entries.sub: "kah sol pyr", level 140, 70 mana, cooldown 10 s

p: Holy fire that burns on the target for 5 s. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key martyrspyre): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Lightward
entries.sub: "tor sol ghar", level 140, 180 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: Cleanses harmful conditions and grants 8s of strong regeneration.

entries.name: Venom Spiral
entries.sub: "kah shur putr", level 150, 85 mana, cooldown 10 s

p: A coiled blade of venom; the target is poisoned for 5 s. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key venomspiral): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Shadowfist Flurry
entries.sub: "kah gal umh dhun", level 150, 180 mana, cooldown 13 s

p: Spend all chi on a flurry of blows at the target next to you: 2 + 1 per chi spent. Finisher. One hit every 0.2 s while the target stays next to you; every hit is a Monk strike, so it crits in the focus window this finisher opens (2.5% per chi spent, x1.5) and counts the target's Pressure Points.

entries.name: Mantra of Stone
entries.sub: "tor vas qhal", level 150, 240 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: Chant for 12 s; you and party members within 6 sqm take 8% less damage while they stay near, and every pulse (2 s) heals them for level x 1 + fist x 26 (the Iron Sage's party heal, ChaosMonk.cfg.mantra.heal). The aura pulses every 2 s: everyone in reach gets a 3 s timer condition (ChaosMonk.ids.subId.mantra) that data/scripts/chaos/monk_combat.lua reads on damage taken. Uses no chi. Stops when the Sage dies or logs out.

entries.name: Cleaving Heel
entries.sub: "kah rhim dhun", level 150, 60 mana, cooldown 8 s

p: A heel that cleaves the target next to you and builds 1 chi. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key cleavingheel): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Shield Wave
entries.sub: "drai sol aeg", level 150, 75 mana, cooldown 4 s

p: Drive your shield forward; a wave of holy force hits your target and everything in front of you. The Sentinel's pack spell (level 150, range 3): the target and every creature in the 3 x 3 tiles in front of you, towards it, take holy damage (PvP rules as the other scripted hits). Numbers and rules: _packtools.lua.

entries.name: Bone Offering
entries.sub: "drai sang oss", level 150, 150 mana, cooldown 10 s

p: The skeleton nearest to the target (range 7) bursts apart: physical damage to every enemy within 2 sqm of it, plus 15% of the skeleton's remaining health; you take 20% less damage for 6 s. The skeleton is gone (raise another one). Needs a skeleton; the Bone Golem is never offered. (level / 5 + magic level x 4.5..6.5 + 80..160) x the level scale (necro_config.lua boneOffering); the shield is a timer condition read by data/scripts/chaos/necromancer_combat.lua.

entries.name: Shadow Ricochet
entries.sub: "kah umh dhun", level 150, 180 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: A shadow-wrapped strike that leaps from your target to up to 4 more monsters nearby. The Shadowfist's pack strike (level 150, range 4): the target, then each jump to the nearest monster within 3 sqm of the last one hit, none twice, a Monk strike each (Pressure Points and the focus crit apply). Players are only hit when they are the target. Numbers and rules: _packtools.lua.

entries.name: Iron Chain
entries.sub: "kah brak vinc", level 150, 180 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: Hurl a chain of iron at your target; it links on to up to 4 more monsters close by. The Iron Sage's pack strike (level 150, range 4): the target, then each link to the nearest monster within 2 sqm of the last one hit, none twice, a Monk strike each. Players are only hit when they are the target. Numbers and rules: _packtools.lua.

entries.name: Falling Pyre
entries.sub: "drai gal vas infr", level 150, 700 mana, cooldown 10 s

p: Marks the target's position, the meteor lands 1.2s later (fire, 5x5) and sets enemies ablaze.

entries.name: Wraithshroud
entries.sub: "fen wrai", level 150, 210 mana, cooldown 35 s

p: 8s of invisibility plus a speed boost.

entries.name: Bushido Focus
entries.sub: "vyr mynd", level 150, 120 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: For 30 seconds your critical chance grows while you take no damage. Every second without taking damage adds a stack (3 at once, 10 at most); each stack is +3% critical chance on weapon hits and weapon strikes (Iaijutsu), a critical hit does x1.5. A hit taken starts the stacks again from zero. (Chaos.classes.bushido; counted by data/scripts/chaos/thief_combat.lua, which sees the buff as a condition with the class sub id.) Recasting refreshes the time and keeps the stacks.

entries.name: Lay on Hands
entries.sub: "saen gal manh", level 150, 240 mana, cooldown 1 min

p: A great heal on one party member within 5 sqm: 35% of its maximum health + magic level x 10 (ChaosTemplar.cfg.layOnHands). Say a name to choose (saen gal manh "Name"); without one it goes to the party member (or the Sentinel) with the lowest health share. Long cooldown.

entries.name: Sunspear
entries.sub: "kah aur lanc", level 160, 115 mana, cooldown 10 s

p: A spear of sunlight, a heavy holy hit on one target. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key sunspear): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Bell of Reckoning
entries.sub: "drai sol krak", level 160, 80 mana, cooldown 9 s

p: A bell tolls over the target; every enemy within 2 sqm of it takes holy damage. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key bellofreckoning): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Corpse Explosion
entries.sub: "drai kadh krak", level 160, 240 mana, cooldown 4 s

p: Up to 3 corpses within 3 sqm of the target (range 7) burst; each burst hits every enemy within 1 sqm of it with death damage. Needs a usable corpse (no loot inside, yours, your party's or nobody's); without one the spell fails and costs nothing. The corpses are consumed. Each burst: (level / 5 + magic level x 2..3 + 40..80) x the level scale, Soul Hoard included (necro_config.lua corpseExplosion).

entries.name: Mirror Shards
entries.sub: "drai umh krak", level 170, 345 mana, cooldown 12 s

p: The glass of a mirror bursts; every enemy next to you is cut. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key mirrorshards): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Crescent Cut
entries.sub: "drai kaen sol", level 170, 85 mana, cooldown 9 s

p: A wide arc in front of you, towards the target, a melee weapon strike on each. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key crescentcut): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Soulrend Beam
entries.sub: "kah nyx lanc", level 170, 270 mana, cooldown 9 s

p: A beam that rends everything in a line 6 sqm long towards the target. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key soulrendbeam): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Vaulting Cleave
entries.sub: "kah brak skai", level 170, 60 mana, cooldown 7 s

p: Jump next to the target (range 5) and strike it with weapon attack and skill.

entries.name: Verdant Sanctuary
entries.sub: "saen gal vas vert", level 180, 360 mana, cooldown 30 s

p: A healing zone on the caster's tile; 8 pulses (1/s) heal allies standing within 3 sqm.

entries.name: Shuriken Barrage
entries.sub: "drai vas shur", level 180, 240 mana, cooldown 7 s

p: A fan of shurikens at your target and up to 4 more monsters near it. One ranged weapon strike each (shuriken power as Shuriken Toss) within 3 sqm of the target. Other players are only hit when they are the spell's target.

entries.name: Mistborne Strike
entries.sub: "ash qhal", level 190, 150 mana, cooldown 12 s

p: A finisher wave of mist 3 sqm ahead. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key mistbornestrike): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Tidal Palm
entries.sub: "drai hyr dhun", level 190, 75 mana, cooldown 9 s

p: An open palm that sends a wave over the 3 x 2 sqm in front of you and builds 1 chi. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key tidalpalm): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Lance of Vigil
entries.sub: "kah sol sag lanc", level 190, 90 mana, cooldown 11 s

entries.name: Skyfall Cleave

The Berserker's leaping slam. Every hit gets Rage (data/scripts/chaos/berserker_combat.lua), and the slam staggers (30% slow, 2 s).

entries.name: Iaido Sweep
entries.sub: "drai gal kaen", level 200, 270 mana, cooldown 10 s

The Samurai's area strike (level 200): the target within 2 sqm and every monster in the 3 x 2 tiles in front of you, towards it, take a melee weapon strike of half an Iaijutsu, without a charge. Other players are only hit when they are the target. Each hit rolls the Bushido crit and carries Poison Blades. Numbers and rules: _blades.lua.

entries.name: Arrowstorm

entries.name: Dreamrot

entries.name: Last Breath
entries.sub: "kah nyx kaen", level 230, 150 mana, cooldown 13 s

p: A heavy finishing thrust at the target next to you, a melee weapon strike. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key lastbreath): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Sanctum Verdict
entries.sub: "kah sol judh brak", level 230, 145 mana, cooldown 13 s

entries.name: Gale Volley

entries.name: Skysplitter Fist
entries.sub: "kah gal sol dhun", level 250, 220 mana, cooldown 13 s

entries.name: Ossuary Surge
entries.sub: "drai oss vael", level 250, 365 mana, cooldown 11 s

p: Bones rise from the floor around you; every enemy within 2 sqm is struck. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key ossuarysurge): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Primordial Squall
entries.sub: "drai gal vas stoma", level 250, 720 mana, cooldown 7 s

p: Three waves (earth, ice, earth) around the caster, the ice wave chills. Cast time 1.5 s (data/lib/chaos_casting.lua): moving, a new paralysis, another spell or death interrupt it and give the mana and cooldown back. Power x1.0 (owner, 2026-10-20: no area discount; was x0.98, x0.85 before the cast time).

entries.name: Crusader's Sweep
entries.sub: "vyr sol zel", level 250, 115 mana, cooldown 13 s

p: A holy sweep 3 sqm ahead, on a target within 2 sqm. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key crusaderssweep): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Colossus Fall
entries.sub: "kah gal vas tyr", level 260, 95 mana, cooldown 10 s

p: Two crushing blows (0 / 0.6s) in a 5x5 circle; enemies are slowed 70% for 4s. Cast time 1 s, a wind-up (data/lib/chaos_casting.lua): moving, a new paralysis, another spell or death interrupt it and give the mana and cooldown back. Damage x1.0 (owner, 2026-10-20: no area discount; was x0.77, x0.7 before the cast time), unchanged when the area went from 7x7 to 5x5 (2026-10-28, class identity: melee fights in melee).

entries.name: Shuriken Tempest
entries.sub: "kah sai vas hyr", level 270, 360 mana, cooldown 13 s

A storm of shurikens at your target and up to 8 more monsters within 4 sqm of it, two ranged weapon strikes each, 0.5 s apart (shuriken power as Shuriken Toss, 1.1 times a Barrage strike). 13 s cooldown (the cooldown ladder, 2026-10-20: 14 s, was 30 s; O176, 2026-10-24: 13 s). Other players are only hit when they are the spell's target.

entries.name: Splinter Volley
entries.sub: "vael oss sag", level 270, 400 mana, cooldown 13 s

p: Bone shards that burst in a circle at the target. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key splintervolley): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Hail of Dawn
entries.sub: "drai gal vas sol volv", level 280, 480 mana, cooldown 13 s

p: 3 volleys of 4 holy arrows, every arrow strikes the target. Scales with distance skill x weapon attack. Cast time 1 s (data/lib/chaos_casting.lua): moving, a new paralysis, another spell or death interrupt it and give the mana and cooldown back; at the end the target must still be alive, attackable, within 7 sqm and in sight. Damage x1.1 since the cast time.

entries.name: Tear in the Weave
entries.sub: "drai zhul riv", level 280, 780 mana, cooldown 13 s

p: Drags monsters within 5 sqm next to the caster (monsters over 20000 max health are not moved), then two arcane-death implosions at 0.6s and 1.2s.

entries.name: Doomtide
entries.sub: "drai zhul infr doma", level 300, 1150 mana, cooldown 13 s

p: Three waves (fire, energy, fire) rolling out from the caster over 6x6 area. Cast time 1.5 s (data/lib/chaos_casting.lua): moving, a new paralysis, another spell or death interrupt it and give the mana and cooldown back. Power x1.38 (was x1.2 before the cast time).

entries.name: Pack Frenzy
entries.sub: "kah ferh vas", level 320, 270 mana, cooldown 6 s

p: Feral Command's late sibling. Your companions leap at the target (range 7) and maul it in a frenzy, each for 3.3 bites at once (Feral Command: 1.5). 6 s cooldown (the cooldown ladder, 2026-10-20; was 20 s). The Beastmaster's command. A bite is physical damage dealt as you, from your level and distance skill (ChaosClasses.biteValues, Chaos.classes.companion); it needs a companion out (Wild Bond).

entries.name: Bastion Cry
entries.sub: "vok gal rhov kor", level 340, 80 mana, cooldown 13 s

p: A shout that hurls a shockwave 3 sqm ahead. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key bastioncry): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua.

entries.name: Anvil Fall
entries.sub: "kah gal brak thun", level 380, 110 mana, cooldown 9 s

p: The Juggernaut brings its weapon down on the target (range 3): one crushing blow to everything in a 5x5 square around it, from weapon attack and skill; every enemy hit is stunned (90% slow) for 2.5 s. 9 s cooldown (the cooldown ladder, 2026-10-20: 12 s, was 20 s; O176, 2026-10-24: 9 s). About 0.8 of Colossus Fall's damage on a smaller area, in one hit (docs/CLASSES.md "Spells by level").

entries.name: Rampage Leap
entries.sub: "drai skai hrun vas", level 380, 95 mana, cooldown 10 s

p: Skyfall Cleave's late sibling. Leap next to the target (range 6) and bring the two-handed weapon down: heavy physical damage to everything in a 5x5 square around the target (about 1.6 times Skyfall Cleave per hit), from weapon attack and skill. Every hit gets Rage (data/scripts/chaos/berserker_combat.lua); the slam staggers (50% slow, 2.5 s). 10 s cooldown (the cooldown ladder, 2026-10-20: 14 s, was 18 s; O176, 2026-10-24: 10 s).

entries.name: Twin Verdict
entries.sub: "kah gal sol judh vael", level 400, 540 mana, cooldown 13 s

p: Two heavy holy strikes at the target 0.6 s apart, each 1.3 times Final Verdict's; +50% against a target below 25% health, checked for each strike. 12 s cooldown (the cooldown ladder, 2026-10-20: 16 s, was 24 s; O176, 2026-10-24: 12 s).

entries.name: Glacial Doom
entries.sub: "drai hyr infr doma", level 420, 1650 mana, cooldown 13 s

p: Doomtide's late sibling in ice. Three waves (ice, energy, ice) rolling out from the caster over a 6x6 area; the energy wave in the middle. 13 s cooldown (the cooldown ladder, 2026-10-20: 20 s, was 60 s; O176, 2026-10-24: 13 s). Cast time 2 s (data/lib/chaos_casting.lua): moving, a new paralysis, another spell or death interrupt it and give the mana and cooldown back. Power x1.9 (Doomtide x1.38; the cast time is longer; before the cooldown ladder the cooldown was also 15 s longer, 2 s now).

One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key soulflaywave): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua. One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key thousandechopalm): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua. entries.name: Pyre of Absolution

One of the attack kit's spells (data/scripts/chaos/attack_kit_config.lua, key pyreofabsolution): the numbers, the shape and the effects are there, the cast is data/spells/chaos/_attackkit.lua. A line spell quest spell: needlearn, taught by the quest.

entries.name: Ironbound Oath
entries.sub: "vok brak ael ruun", level 800, 150 mana, cooldown 90 s

p: A vow sworn in iron. For 20 s your melee skill is 20% higher and your shielding 25% higher. The level 800 buff of the Warrior line's spell quest (needlearn, taught by Archivist Odrenna; numbers in data/scripts/chaos/quest_buffs_config.lua). No pacify and no lock on other spells.

entries.name: Unblinking Gaze
entries.sub: "vyr oth sag ael", level 800, 300 mana, cooldown 90 s

p: The hunt narrows to one point. For 20 s your distance skill is 25% higher and you crit 10 points more often. The level 800 buff of the Ranger line's spell quest (needlearn, taught by Archivist Odrenna; numbers in data/scripts/chaos/quest_buffs_config.lua).

entries.name: Veil of Whispers
entries.sub: "tor zhul vael nyx", level 800, 400 mana, cooldown 90 s

p: Secrets lend power. For 20 s your magic level is 15% higher and 1% of your maximum mana comes back every second. The level 800 buff of the Mystic line's spell quest (needlearn, taught by Archivist Odrenna; numbers in data/scripts/chaos/quest_buffs_config.lua). The regeneration is a second condition (sub id + regenOffset) beside the buff's own.

entries.name: Shroud of Knives
entries.sub: "fen nyx kaen umh", level 800, 200 mana, cooldown 90 s

p: Steel you do not see. For 15 s your melee and distance skill are 20% higher and you dodge 10 points more weapon hits (data/scripts/chaos/thief_combat.lua adds the evasion). The level 800 buff of the Thief line's spell quest (needlearn, taught by Archivist Odrenna; numbers in data/scripts/chaos/quest_buffs_config.lua). The caster stays visible: no stealth, no lock on other spells.

entries.name: Dirge of the Legion
entries.sub: "tor oss vael kyng", level 800, 300 mana, cooldown 90 s

p: A funeral song that wakes. For 20 s your minions hit 25% harder and your death spells deal 10% more. The level 800 buff of the Necromancer line's spell quest (needlearn, taught by Archivist Odrenna; numbers in data/scripts/chaos/quest_buffs_config.lua). A timer condition: data/scripts/chaos/necro_minions.lua (minions) and passivetree_effects.lua (death spells) read it. It works without minions out: the death spells still gain.

entries.name: Lotus Stance
entries.sub: "saen qhal mil dhun", level 800, 200 mana, cooldown 90 s

p: Stillness that blooms. For 15 s every weapon or fist hit gives one more chi and you dodge 10 points more weapon hits. The level 800 buff of the Monk line's spell quest (needlearn, taught by Archivist Odrenna; numbers in data/scripts/chaos/quest_buffs_config.lua). A timer condition: data/scripts/chaos/monk_combat.lua reads it.

entries.name: Mantle of Dawn
entries.sub: "tor sol aur emb", level 800, 250 mana, cooldown 90 s

p: Light worn as armour. For 20 s you take 15% less damage and the holy strike after your melee hits is 20% stronger. The level 800 buff of the Templar line's spell quest (needlearn, taught by Archivist Odrenna; numbers in data/scripts/chaos/quest_buffs_config.lua). A timer condition: data/scripts/chaos/templar_combat.lua reads it.

entries.name: Judgment of Iron
entries.sub: "vok aeg mor thun", level 1200, 285 mana, cooldown 45 s

p: The ground answers for every wall: a blow to every enemy within 3 sqm of you.

entries.name: Dawnbreaker Shot
entries.sub: "drai sol aur vyx", level 1200, 345 mana, cooldown 40 s

p: One arrow that ends the night: a holy shot that pierces every enemy in a line of 8 sqm.

entries.name: Eclipse of Ruin
entries.sub: "drai ecl zhul vorn", level 1200, 4950 mana, cooldown 50 s

p: Daylight dies over the pack: ice in a circle of radius 4 around the target.

entries.name: Death Between Heartbeats
entries.sub: "kah nyx mor kaen", level 1200, 450 mana, cooldown 35 s

p: The shortest wait in the world: a melee blade strike that crits a target above half health.

entries.name: Funeral of Kings
entries.sub: "drai oss mor kyng", level 1200, 1200 mana, cooldown 50 s

p: Every grave opens at once: death in a circle of radius 4 around the target.

entries.name: Heaven's Ninth Gate
entries.sub: "kah nin dhun sol", level 1200, 660 mana, cooldown 40 s

p: The last door opens inward: a melee chi finisher that hits with the chi it spends.

entries.name: Hammer of Ember Dawn
entries.sub: "kah sol emb hamr", level 1200, 435 mana, cooldown 45 s

p: The sun lands: a heavy holy blow on the target and half of it on every enemy within 2 sqm.

entries.name: The passive tree
entries.sub: Points, presets, resets and the Paragon track.

p: One point every 4 levels above level 8 (passive tree points from bosses come on top). Keystones change how you play; notables are strong named nodes on the paths. Every class sees the main tree, and the Thief, Monk, Necromancer and Templar lines also a class section.
Up to 6 presets. A full reset costs 250 gold x your level; a single node can be refunded too.
After level 1000: 1 Paragon point per level up to level 1100, then one every 6 levels (all of the track by level 2192), spent on small capped stats.

entries.name: Aether Edge
entries.sub: Keystone. Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

p: Monk and Templar lines: your weapon and fist hits add 6% of your current energy shield as energy damage. Your maximum health is 20% less.
Classes: Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

entries.name: Arcane Echo
entries.sub: Keystone. Mystic, Elementalist.

p: Spells that hit 2 or more enemies: 35% chance to echo 0.6 s later on the same spots for 50% of their damage. Cooldown 3 s.
Classes: Mystic, Elementalist.

entries.name: Barbed Quiver
entries.sub: Keystone. Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster.

p: Ranger line: bow, crossbow and thrown weapon hits bleed for 60% of the hit as physical damage over 4 s. The hit itself deals 10% less.
Classes: Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster.

entries.name: Bastion
entries.sub: Keystone. Sentinel.

p: Your aura: 4% less damage more and 1 sqm wider. Aegis of Faith also covers the party members under your aura, at half strength.
Classes: Sentinel.

entries.name: Blackblood Creed
entries.sub: Keystone. Thief, Ninja, Samurai.

p: Thief line: every attack poisons the target as Poison Blades does, with or without the buff: auto attacks and all attack spells, single target and area. Your poison deals +30% damage. Your evasion is halved.
Classes: Thief, Ninja, Samurai.

entries.name: Bone Colossus
entries.sub: Keystone. Bone Lord.

p: Your Bone Golem hits +60% harder and has +50% health.
Classes: Bone Lord.

entries.name: Bulwark
entries.sub: Keystone. Warrior, Juggernaut.

p: With a shield: 15% chance to block a melee or ranged attack completely, and 30% of melee damage taken is reflected to the attacker.
Classes: Warrior, Juggernaut.

entries.name: Cascade Edge
entries.sub: Keystone. every class.

p: A critical hit releases a burst on the other enemies within 1 sqm of its target for 60% of the hit, of your strongest tree element (energy if none), at most once every 0.8 s. Your non-critical hits deal 5% less.
Classes: every class.

entries.name: Cleaving Arc
entries.sub: Keystone. Warrior, Berserker.

p: Two-handed melee hits cleave: up to 3 other enemies next to you take 40% of the hit.
Classes: Warrior, Berserker.

entries.name: Contagion Rite
entries.sub: Keystone. Thief, Ninja, Samurai.

p: Thief line: a monster that dies with your poison on it spreads it to 3 monsters within 2 sqm (5 ticks of its last tick). Spread poison spreads again, up to 4 deep. Your weapon hits deal 10% less.
Classes: Thief, Ninja, Samurai.

entries.name: Corpse Detonation
entries.sub: Keystone. Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord.

p: A monster you or your minions kill explodes: 12% of its maximum health (at most 15 x your level) as death damage on up to 6 enemies within 2 sqm. Your and your minions' hits deal 8% less.
Classes: Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord.

entries.name: Covenant of Vigils
entries.sub: Keystone. Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

p: Mystic, Necromancer and Templar lines: your vigils reserve 30% less, reach 3 sqm farther and give your party members 20% more of every effect. Your own damage is 10% less.
Classes: Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

entries.name: Covenant of the Grave
entries.sub: Keystone. Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord.

p: Necromancer line: your minions deal +50% damage (Bone Lord: +20% damage) and have +50% health. Your own spells deal 25% less damage.
Classes: Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord.

entries.name: Dawnchain
entries.sub: Keystone. Templar, Inquisitor.

p: Melee weapon hits chain holy light to the nearest other enemy within 3 sqm for 55% of the hit, then once more for 55% of that (30%). Never the same target twice. Your spells deal 10% less.
Classes: Templar, Inquisitor.

entries.name: Deadeye
entries.sub: Keystone. Ranger, Deadeye.

p: Crossbow and bolts: 15% chance for a Deadeye shot that deals double damage (+100%).
Classes: Ranger, Deadeye.

entries.name: Divine Verdict
entries.sub: Keystone. Inquisitor.

p: Your Radiant Strikes have a 20% chance to judge their target (Judgement: +20% holy damage taken from everyone for 8 s).
Classes: Inquisitor.

entries.name: Earthbreaker
entries.sub: Keystone. Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker.

p: Warrior line: every 4th melee hit deals 50% more and slams the ground: up to 6 other enemies within 2 sqm take 60% of that hit as physical damage. Your other melee hits deal 10% less.
Classes: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker.

entries.name: Effigy Covenant
entries.sub: Keystone. Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord.

p: Mystic and Necromancer lines: an attack spell hitting 2 or more enemies raises a Cinder Effigy on your tile (at most 2, for 12 s). Every 2 s it repeats the cast within 3 sqm of it for 24% of the cast's average hit. Your spells deal 25% less.
Classes: Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord.

entries.name: Elemental Overload
entries.sub: Keystone. Mystic, Elementalist.

p: A spell hit primes the other elements: your next spell of a different element within 8 s deals +20% damage.
Classes: Mystic, Elementalist.

entries.name: Executioner's Verdict
entries.sub: Keystone. Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker.

p: Warrior line: a melee or spell hit that would leave a monster (not a boss) at 15% of its health or less kills it. Your melee and spell hits on monsters above 60% health deal 10% less.
Classes: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker.

entries.name: Flowing Mercy
entries.sub: Keystone. Iron Sage.

p: Kindled Breath also heals the next most hurt party member for 40% of it (and its heal over time).
Classes: Iron Sage.

entries.name: Hoarded Souls
entries.sub: Keystone. Lich.

p: Soul Hoard: +40% spell damage per empty shade slot (instead of 25%), and +15% while your shade is out.
Classes: Lich.

entries.name: Hobbling Shot
entries.sub: Keystone. Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster.

p: Ranger line: bow, crossbow and thrown weapon hits have a 25% chance to hobble the target for 3 s (40% slower). Your hits on a hobbled target deal 20% more, on any other 8% less.
Classes: Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster.

entries.name: Hollow Vessel
entries.sub: Keystone. Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

p: Mystic, Necromancer, Monk and Templar lines: your maximum health is 100. Your energy shield: the items' +50%, plus 50% of the health given up. It recharges 15% of its maximum a second faster and starts 1 s after a hit. No poison, no life drain can hurt you. Heals and leech fill only the 100.
Classes: Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

entries.name: Hundred Hands
entries.sub: Keystone. Shadowfist.

p: Focus critical hits also give you a chi (at most one per second).
Classes: Shadowfist.

entries.name: Hunter's Focus
entries.sub: Keystone. Deadeye.

p: Bow and crossbow hits on the same target deal +4% more each, up to +20%. Another target (or 6 s without a hit) starts again.
Classes: Deadeye.

entries.name: Immovable
entries.sub: Keystone. Juggernaut.

p: You take 8% less damage, 16% less while below 50% health.
Classes: Juggernaut.

entries.name: Inspiring Illusion
entries.sub: Keystone. Illusionist.

p: Support (needs a party): other party members within 8 sqm of you deal +8% damage.
Classes: Illusionist.

entries.name: Iron Tithe
entries.sub: Keystone. Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

p: Warrior, Monk and Templar lines: your vigils reserve maximum health instead of mana, at 60% of their share. They work on you alone, 50% stronger. No effect next to Hollow Vessel.
Classes: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

entries.name: Last Stand
entries.sub: Keystone. Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker.

p: Warrior line: a hit that would take you below 20% of your maximum health is cut so you keep 20%; then you take 40% less damage for 5 s. Once every 90 s, not against players. Healing you receive is 20% less.
Classes: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker.

entries.name: Living Shadow
entries.sub: Keystone. Ninja.

p: A dodge, or your first hit out of Shadow Veil, opens a 4 s window: your weapon hits and strikes deal +25% damage.
Classes: Ninja.

entries.name: Longshot
entries.sub: Keystone. Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster.

p: Ranger line: bow, crossbow and thrown weapon hits deal 6% more for every square of distance beyond 2, at most 30% more. Hits from 2 sqm or closer deal 15% less.
Classes: Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster.

entries.name: Open Hand Creed
entries.sub: Keystone. Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

p: Every line but the Monk's. With no weapon in your hands (a shield is fine) your fists hit with the Monk's fist attack (40 + level / 40, at most 60) and your best melee skill, +10% damage.
Classes: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Thief, Ninja, Samurai, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

entries.name: Opening Shot
entries.sub: Keystone. Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster.

p: Ranger line: your first bow, crossbow or thrown weapon hit on a monster at full health deals 80% more. Your other such hits deal 7% less.
Classes: Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster.

entries.name: Overgrowth
entries.sub: Keystone. Iron Sage.

p: Heals you cast on others also plant regrowth: 10% of the heal again over 6 s (3 pulses). A new heal adds its share to what is left.
Classes: Iron Sage.

entries.name: Pack Alpha
entries.sub: Keystone. Beastmaster.

p: Your companions' bites and Feral Command deal +35% damage, and companions take 20% less.
Classes: Beastmaster.

entries.name: Penitent's Wrath
entries.sub: Keystone. Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

p: Templar line: a melee or ranged hit you take is answered with a holy strike on the attacker for 40% of the damage + 4 x magic level (at most one every 0.5 s). Your defence aura's damage reduction is halved (for the party too).
Classes: Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

entries.name: Piercing Palm
entries.sub: Keystone. Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage.

p: Melee hits (fists or weapon) pass through: the enemy behind the target takes 70% of the hit, the next one behind it 40%. The hit itself deals 5% less.
Classes: Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage.

entries.name: Pyre Oath
entries.sub: Keystone. Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

p: Warrior and Templar lines. Out of a protection zone and in a fight, enemies within 2 sqm take 4% of your maximum health as fire damage every second. You burn for 2.5% of your maximum health a second (never lethal; your fire absorbs count) and regenerate 2% of it a second. Your other damage is 25% less.
Classes: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

entries.name: Radiant Rebuke
entries.sub: Keystone. Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

p: With a shield: 20% chance to block a melee or ranged attack completely. A block sends a holy nova (once per 1 s): up to 8 enemies within 2 sqm take the blocked hit + 4 x your magic level. Your weapon hits deal 10% less.
Classes: Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

entries.name: Rampage
entries.sub: Keystone. Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker.

p: Warrior line: killing a monster gives a stack (at most 5; they end 6 s after the last kill). Each stack: you deal 6% more damage and take 4% more damage.
Classes: Warrior, Juggernaut, Berserker.

entries.name: Reaper's Toll
entries.sub: Keystone. Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord.

p: Your and your minions' hits on a monster at 40% health or less deal 100% more; on a monster above 40% they deal 8% less.
Classes: Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord.

entries.name: Reliquary Vow
entries.sub: Keystone. Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

p: Templar line: a Reliquary Warden follows you. Every 2 s it heals you and your party within 3 sqm (0.6% of maximum health + 2 x your magic level), the others deal +5% damage for 3 s, and enemies within 2 sqm take 0.6 x level + 3 x magic level as holy damage. Your damage is 10% less.
Classes: Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

entries.name: Ricochet
entries.sub: Keystone. Ranger, Beastmaster.

p: Bow and crossbow hits: 100% chance to ricochet to the nearest other enemy within 4 sqm for 65% of the hit, then once more for 65% of that (42%). Never the same target twice.
Classes: Ranger, Beastmaster.

entries.name: Sanguine Covenant
entries.sub: Keystone. every class.

p: Every hit you deal leeches 5% of its damage as health, at most 6% of your maximum health in any second. Healing you receive is 30% less.
Classes: every class.

entries.name: Scarred Discipline
entries.sub: Keystone. Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage.

p: Monk line: a hit you take gives 1 chi (at most one every 2 s); while you hold 3 chi or more you take 10% less damage. You can no longer dodge.
Classes: Monk, Shadowfist, Iron Sage.

entries.name: Seventh Palm
entries.sub: Keystone. Monk, Shadowfist.

p: Every 5th melee hit (fists or weapon) within 4 s is a finisher: 120% more damage, and a shockwave hits up to 4 enemies next to the target for 50% of it. Your other melee hits deal 10% less.
Classes: Monk, Shadowfist.

entries.name: Shadow Twin
entries.sub: Keystone. Thief, Ninja, Samurai.

p: Weapon hits: 30% chance for your shadow to strike the same target again 0.3 s later for 60% of the hit. You take 6% more damage.
Classes: Thief, Ninja, Samurai.

entries.name: Shared Phantasm
entries.sub: Keystone. Illusionist.

p: Support (needs a party): your hits mark the enemy for 6 s. Other party members deal +12% damage to a marked enemy and heal for 4% of it.
Classes: Illusionist.

entries.name: Sigil of Cinders
entries.sub: Keystone. Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

p: Mystic and Templar lines: fire and holy spell hits ignite (15% of the hit over 4 s). A spell that hits one enemy brands it for 8 s: every second the sigil burns enemies within 1 sqm for 5% of that hit and jumps on when its bearer dies; ignited monsters spread the burn to 2 more when they die. Damage that is not fire or holy is 20% less.
Classes: Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Templar, Inquisitor, Sentinel.

entries.name: Snarewright's Creed
entries.sub: Keystone. Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Thief, Ninja, Samurai.

p: Ranger and Thief lines: 2 more traps and 3 more mines may be out at once; they arm in 50% of the time and hit 25% harder. Your other hits (weapon, spells; not damage over time) are 15% less.
Classes: Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster, Thief, Ninja, Samurai.

entries.name: Stormstring
entries.sub: Keystone. Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster.

p: Ranger line: bow and crossbow hits arc to 3 other enemies within 3 sqm for 40% of the hit as energy damage. The hit on its own target deals 10% less.
Classes: Ranger, Deadeye, Beastmaster.

entries.name: Thornbound Oath
entries.sub: Keystone. every class.

p: A hit taken from a creature reflects 20% of what landed (and your Reflect Damage once more) as physical damage, at most 50% of your maximum health a hit. Players take a third (at most 5% of their health a hit), bosses half (at most 2 x your level a second). Your damage is 10% less.
Classes: every class.

entries.name: Thorns
entries.sub: Keystone. Sentinel.

p: Melee and ranged attackers take earth damage back: 30% of their hit + 2 x your magic level.
Classes: Sentinel.

entries.name: Undying Rage
entries.sub: Keystone. Berserker.

p: Melee weapon hits heal you for 4% of the damage dealt, 8% while below 50% health.
Classes: Berserker.

entries.name: Viper's Verdict
entries.sub: Keystone. Thief, Ninja, Samurai.

p: Weapon hits on a poisoned target: 20% chance to strike a vital for double damage (+100%). Weapon hits on a target that is not poisoned deal 15% less.
Classes: Thief, Ninja, Samurai.

entries.name: Way of the Blade
entries.sub: Keystone. Samurai.

p: Counter Stance parries every melee hit while it lasts (not only the first). Bushido Focus: a hit taken keeps half of the stacks.
Classes: Samurai.

entries.name: Winter's Lattice
entries.sub: Keystone. Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord.

p: Mystic and Necromancer lines: a monster that dies within 2 s of your ice hit shatters: enemies within 2 sqm take 6% of its maximum health as ice damage (at most 12 x your level). Kills shatter again. Your fire and energy damage is 30% less.
Classes: Mystic, Elementalist, Illusionist, Necromancer, Lich, Bone Lord.
